item.name: CT001.001 - Retrieve existing user by ID

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response is valid JSON', function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test('Response contains data object', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('data'); });
pm.test('Returned user ID matches request', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.id).to.eql(2); });

item.name: CT001.002 - Retrieve non-existent user by ID

exec: pm.test('Status code is 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('Response body is valid JSON', function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test('Response body is empty object', function () { pm.expect(Object.keys(pm.response.json())).to.have.lengthOf(0); });

item.name: CT001.003 - Retrieve existing user without x-api-key (Known Finding)

exec: pm.test('Known Finding (Observed Behavior): status code is 200 without x-api-key', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Known Finding: response still contains user 2 data', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('data'); pm.expect(body.data.id).to.eql(2); });

item.name: CT002.001 - Create user with valid data

exec: pm.test('Status code is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Response is valid JSON', function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test('Response contains generated id', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('id'); });
pm.test('Response contains createdAt timestamp', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('createdAt'); });
pm.test('Response data matches request data', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.name).to.eql('QA Tester'); pm.expect(body.job).to.eql('QA Engineer'); });
pm.test('Status code is 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('Response indicates missing or invalid api key', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.error).to.be.oneOf(['missing_api_key', 'invalid_api_key']); });

item.name: CT002.003 - Create user with empty body payload (Validation Finding)

exec: pm.test('Validation Finding (Observed Behavior): status code is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

pm.test('Observed response contains generated id and createdAt', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('createdAt'); });
